rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound sa+aṣṭa+aṅga indicating a prostration involving eight body parts
particle marking a subsequent point in the ritual instruction
bahuvrīhi compound pañca+aṅga indicating a prostration involving five body parts
tatpuruṣa compound pūjā+karman denoting ritual acts of worship
past participle expressing sanctioned acceptance in ritual practice

items.question: Which bodily forms of prostration are sanctioned for acts of worship?
premises: Prostration may be performed with eight limbs.
Prostration may alternatively be performed with five limbs.
Both forms are approved in acts of worship.
items.inference: Therefore, either eight-limbed or five-limbed prostration is sanctioned in worship acts.
items.plain_english: Then, in acts of worship, prostration performed with eight limbs or with five limbs is approved.
